ctaTitle: You are welcome in this house.
ministriesText: From the Mothers' Union to youth ministry, cell groups to evangelism: there is a place for everyone to belong, grow in faith, and serve across the Diocese.
heroSubtext: An Anglican family of more than 47,000 believers in Aweil East, equipping the Church for mission and raising up faithful Christian leaders.
missionText: We exist to equip the Church for mission and to raise up faithful Christian leaders, serving South Sudan not only in worship, but in education, health, peace, and humanitarian care.
storyParagraph: One of the youngest and fastest-growing dioceses in the Episcopal Church of South Sudan, created as an area diocese in 2017 and made autonomous in 2019. Today the Diocese is home to more than 47,000 believers, under the leadership of its first bishop, Rt. Rev. Joseph Mamer Manot.
ctaSubtext: Join us for worship this Sunday, or reach out any day of the week. We would be glad to hear from you.
